concern_summary: This concern focuses on the management of workspace categories, enabling users to configure default categories and set requirements for category usage within a workspace.
Management of policy categories and tags, allowing users to enable, disable, delete, and manipulate these components according to user interactions.

This concern encompasses the functionalities related to managing options for vendors and limit types associated with financial transactions, allowing users to select appropriate settings for their expenses and card configurations.
Management of workspace member functionalities, including inviting new members, updating their participation in chats, and generating associated reports based on their accounts.

This concern relates to the management and display of invoices within the workspace, including functionalities for viewing, sending, and interacting with invoices, particularly focusing on unpaid invoices.

This concern revolves around retrieving the sender workspace associated with participants to manage monetary requests, ensuring accurate transaction tracing within the context of workspace member interactions.
This concern involves selecting and managing accounts in the Xero system, allowing users to update reimbursement and invoice collection accounts seamlessly.
